top_stories.title: Cooling appliances’ demand surges ahead of Eidul Azha - Business - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: Despite rising living costs, appliance sales have increased in the lead-up to Eidul Azha. **Sohail Malik**, finance secretary of the **Karachi Electronic Dealers Association (KEDA)**, reported a 25-30% increase in refrigerator and deep freezer sales compared to last year.  **Pak Elektron (PAEL)**, a leading appliance manufacturer, attributes this growth to consumers' need for cooling appliances to store Qurbani meat. The company projects strong recovery in appliance sales due to economic stability, easing import restrictions, lower interest rates, and increased consumer financing.

top_stories.title: Squeals of horror over price caps – but how are we going to fix our broken food system? | Food & drink industry | The Guardian
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Treasury** is asking UK supermarkets to cap price rises on essential foods in response to rising food prices, a move met with criticism from industry figures. The surge in food prices is attributed to global factors like the Iran war and a record-breaking El Niño event, highlighting vulnerabilities in the global food system.  These disruptions, coupled with climate change impacts like drought and extreme weather events, are causing significant challenges for British farmers and increasing the cost of living crisis.  The UK's reliance on imports for key resources like fertilizer and fossil gas further exacerbates these issues. The government acknowledges the need for a more resilient food system but faces resistance from market-driven approaches.

top_stories.title: Bomb attack in Pakistan’s Balochistan province kills more than 20 people | Conflict News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: A bomb attack in Quetta, the capital of Pakistan's Balochistan province, killed at least 20 people and injured over 50 others. The **Balochistan Liberation Army** claimed responsibility for the explosion which occurred when a train passed through the city.  The blast caused several carriages to overturn and catch fire, damaging nearby houses and buildings.  Hospitals in Quetta declared a state of emergency as medical staff were ordered to remain on duty.

top_stories.title: 'Obsession with our country's most cherished structure': Trump reacts to White House shooting - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **President Donald Trump** reacted to a shooting near the White House, praising **Secret Service** and law enforcement for their swift action that resulted in the suspect's death. The suspect, identified as Nasire Best, was shot by **Secret Service** personnel after allegedly firing multiple rounds at officers stationed near a security checkpoint.  The incident occurred while **Trump** was inside the White House during diplomatic discussions related to Iran and a proposed peace framework involving Middle Eastern nations.

top_stories.title: 2008 railway exam assault: Raj Thackeray's role in instigating attack not proved, says court - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: A **Thane** court acquitted **Raj Thackeray** and five others in a 14-year-old case of alleged assault on Railway Recruitment Board examinees at Kalyan station. The court found the prosecution failed to prove **Thackeray's** presence or that he incited the attack, as key witnesses could not identify him, and the evidence was deemed inadmissible due to its lack of preservation and production.  The court also noted that injuries sustained by witnesses could have resulted from a stampede.

top_stories.title: TikToker held in Faisalabad for using obscene language for female tourists in Naran - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: A **TikToker** from Faisalabad, Yousuf, was arrested for making a video of female tourists at lake Saif-ul-Muluk using obscene language. The **Roshanwala Police** registered a case against him after identifying the suspect and he later confessed to profiting from creating such videos. In another incident, a 16-year-old girl suffering from cancer was allegedly kidnapped, gang-raped, and filmed by three individuals including a father and son in Faisalabad. The **Saddar Police** arrested the accused father and son based on the victim's mother's complaint.

top_stories.title: Russian attacks on Ukraine’s Kyiv kill at least four people | Russia-Ukraine war News | Al Jazeera
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Russia** launched a massive missile and drone attack on **Kyiv**, Ukraine, killing at least four people and injuring over 60. The attack involved hypersonic missiles, including the Oreshnik, as well as drones and conventional missiles.  The **Russian** defense ministry claimed the strikes were in response to attacks on Russian-occupied territory. **Ukrainian** officials reported damage to residential buildings, offices, shops, and a metro station in the capital.

top_stories.title: RInfra Q4 net profit falls to Rs 918 cr; company appoints Vijesh Babu Thota as CEO - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Reliance Infrastructure** reported a net profit of Rs 4,387.08 crore in the same quarter last year, but its total income fell to Rs 4,154.34 crore for the January-March period of FY26 from Rs 4,268.05 crore in the previous fiscal. Expenses increased to Rs 5,419.87 crore, driven by higher power costs, which reached Rs 3,285.68 crore. The company's annual income dropped to Rs 20,862.03 crore from Rs 23,999.29 crore in the previous fiscal year. **Reliance Infrastructure** appointed Vijesh Babu Thota as CEO effective May 23 and Asheesh Chaturvedi as the new CFO.

top_stories.title: Taiwan Elections Spark Controversy with 'No Indian Workers' Billboards | World News - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Lee Hung-Yi**, an independent candidate in Taiwan's upcoming local elections, has sparked controversy with billboards featuring a turbaned man with a "no entry" sign. **Joseph Wu**, former foreign minister and current National Security Council secretary general, condemned the campaign as "despicable conduct." The billboards have unsettled the small but growing Indian community on the island, who say they are part of an online anti-India sentiment fueled by limited people-to-people contact and political campaigns against a potential influx of Indian workers. Despite attempts to reach him for comment, **Lee Hung-Yi** could not be reached.

top_stories.title: More facts surface ahead of high profile One Constitution project case hearing - Pakistan - DAWN.COM
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Islamabad High Court** is set to resume hearing the One Constitution project, with new details emerging regarding a 2012 arbitration award between **Abdul Hafeez Sheikh** of M BNP and **Nadeem Zia Pirzada** of M/s Paragon. The agreement stipulated that BNP would hold 75% ownership with Sheikh and 25% with Pirzada, subject to a forensic audit.  The court record also includes a petition concerning a dispute between BNP and the Bank of Punjab, signed by Ejazul Ahsan who later became a judge of the Supreme Court. Notably, Ahsan was part of the IHC bench that restored the controversial lease of the One Constitution Avenue project.
